All 9 tests pass (4 committed + 5 added). Only the five allowed files were modified. ## Design summary **`review-store.mjs`** — `createReviewStore({ now } = {})` wraps a private `Map` keyed by `runId`. It throws `TypeError` for a non-function `now`, a non-object/array input, or non-string fields. `save` validates input fully *before* calling `now()` exactly once, and throws `TypeError` on a non-empty-string violation without mutating the map (updates stay atomic). Inserts share one timestamp for `createdAt`/`updatedAt`; updates preserve `createdAt`. Stored reviews contain exactly the six contract keys, and every input is copied in and every result copied out, so neither caller-side nor returned-value mutation can leak into stored state. `list` sorts with `<`/`>` (locale-independent): `updatedAt` descending, `runId` ascending on ties. **`review-api.mjs`** — `createReviewApi(store)` validates the store has callable `save`/`get`/`list` (else `TypeError`) and returns the `handleReviewRequest` function directly. One `respond` helper builds a fresh `{ status, headers, body }` per call, so a 405's `allow` header can never poison later responses. POST accumulates *all* field problems (sorted unknown-field names as a `body` error, type errors, then trimmed format/length/note-required checks) and never calls `save` on invalid data; 201 insert / 200 update. GET collection computes a global summary from one unfiltered `list()` and filters only `reviews`; invalid `?decision=` (including empty) → standard validation error. Detail route decodes one non-empty segment with a `try/catch` guard. Malformed request objects/URLs → `invalid_request`; recognized routes with wrong methods → 405 with `allow` (`GET, POST` / `GET`); everything else → `not_found`. **`review-page.mjs`** — complete HTML document with an attribute-free `
